intent: One film out of ten silent recordings of buying eight children's books for people who commented under a Threads post, with Claude in the browser doing the ordering. Dead air dropped, AI-thinking stretches fast-forwarded, every card number / CVV / IBAN / phone / email / recipient record blurred, city names deliberately left readable. Rendered silent: the voice-over is stage 2.

inputs._comment: Chronological. Windows names a capture for when it STOPPED, Android for when it STARTED, and the PXL clip is stamped in UTC -- so this order is not the filename order.

sources.what: monobank on the phone: card list, opening a card
Privat24: the new Universal card and the 10 000 UAH transfer that funds it
the Threads post and its ~55 comments; Claude collects who asked for what
Privat24 card details -- CARRIES THE FULL PAN IN PLAIN TEXT
handheld cutaway of the desk, shot on the phone
the bulk of the ordering and paying
the rest of the orders, payments and confirmation DMs

duplicates_ignored: ~/Videos/Screen Recordings/* -- byte-identical copies Windows writes alongside the ones in ~/Videos

controls.cut: cut.* in the manifest; --target M:SS solves keep_speed and speed together
controls.blur: sources[].blur -- desktop entries generated from temp/pii/*.pii.json, phone entries measured by hand
controls.regions: regions.main / regions.panel; the Edge side-panel divider is x=0.748
controls.activity: temp/*.activity.json, rebuilt by screen-activity.py if a source changes
controls.redaction: TRACKED, not time-windowed: scripts/track-blur.py follows each secret's own pixels (NCC template matching, pooled --pii across all desktop scans) and writes mask streams under temp/track/<base>/; sources[].track points at them and screen-cut blurs the frame once through the mask. Hand rects remain in sources[].blur/blur_extra for what templates cannot see: selected (recolored) text, window-switcher thumbnails, fields OCR missed, stylised card faces, and the handheld clip (NCC recall 14% on a photographed screen).
controls.blur_mode: cut.blur_mode='blur' -- a real gaussian via downscale/gblur/upscale; never boxes, never pixelate mosaic, never whole regions

notes: Rendered with -an on purpose: every source is silent and the voice-over is stage 2.
scan-pii.py found NOTHING in the monobank clip while two full PANs were on screen -- its report is a net, not a clearance.
The user chose 8:00 from a priced menu and 'blur everything but keep the city name'.

The render-pipeline test manifest (temp/rendertest.json) was a throwaway for proving the filtergraph end to end before spending a full encode; its deliverable entry was removed as it is not a render of this video.
User: blur, never black-out; never wipe whole screens or panels; the Claude chat stays readable except the sensitive field itself; uploads unlisted.
